    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersCherry blossom crostiniToasted baguette with whipped ricotta and honey thyme cherriesHow to make it1 baguette250g ricotta300g frozen cherries2 tbsp honey2 sprigs of thymeSlice the baguette and toast until golden.Simmer the cherries with honey and thyme until jammy, then cool.Whip the ricotta until smooth.Spread the toasts with ricotta and spoon the cherries on top.Falcon wingsJoaquin's wings, baked crisp with paprika and honey barbecue glazeHow to make it1kg chicken wings2 tsp smoked paprika125ml barbecue sauce2 tbsp honey30g buttersalt, to tasteToss the wings with paprika and salt.Bake at 220°C until crisp.Warm the barbecue sauce, honey and butter until glossy.Toss the wings through the glaze and serve with napkins.Louisiana crab cakes with remouladeSam's family home in LouisianaHow to make itAs written, serves 4Crab meat bound with mayo, mustard, spring onion and breadcrumbs, shaped and pan-fried until golden, with a lemon remoulade.Mix 400g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 beaten egg, 2 sliced spring onions, a pinch of cayenne and 50g panko crumbs.Shape into 8 cakes and chill 30 minutes.Coat in more panko and pan-fry in oil and butter for 3 minutes a side until golden.For remoulade, mix 120g mayo with 1 tbsp chopped capers, 1 tbsp chopped gherkin, 1 tsp paprika, lemon juice and parsley.Serve with lemon wedges.MainsSam's Louisiana gumboDark roux gumbo with chicken, smoked sausage, capsicum and celeryHow to make it60g plain flour60ml vegetable oil1 brown onion1 green capsicum2 celery stalks600g chicken thighs300g smoked sausage200g okra1.5 L water300g long grain riceDice the onion, capsicum and celery and slice the sausage and chicken.Cook the flour in the oil, stirring, until dark brown.Add the onion, capsicum and celery and soften them.Add the chicken, sausage, okra and water and simmer.Cook the rice and serve the gumbo over it.Red Hulk eye fillet with red wine jusSince when were they red? Medium-rare, sir.How to make itAs written, serves 4Beef eye fillet roasted to medium-rare with a red wine sauce, potato gratin and asparagus.Season a 1kg beef eye fillet, sear all over in a hot pan and roast at 200°C for 20 to 25 minutes for medium-rare.Rest 10 minutes.Slice 1kg potatoes thinly, layer in a buttered dish with 300ml cream, garlic and salt, and bake at 180°C for 60 minutes before the beef goes in.Deglaze the beef pan with 200ml red wine, add 200ml beef stock and reduce by half, then whisk in 20g butter.Serve with steamed asparagus.SweetsCherry blossom pavlovaRoss and Betty's cherry blossoms: meringue, cream, cherries, rose petalsHow to make it4 egg whites220g caster sugar, for the meringue300ml thickened cream500g frozen cherries2 tbsp caster sugar, for the cherries1 packet edible rose petalsWhisk the egg whites to stiff peaks, then add the meringue sugar a spoon at a time until glossy.Shape into a round on a lined tray.Bake at 120°C, then cool in the oven.Cook the cherries briefly with the cherry sugar and whip the cream.Top the pavlova with cream, cherries and rose petals.DrinksPonchatoula strawberry lemon fizzStrawberry puree and lemon juice over ice, topped with bubblesHow to make it300g strawberries3 tbsp caster sugar2 lemons800ml soda water1 bag iceHull the strawberries, keeping four for garnish. Juice one lemon and peel strips from the other.Blitz the rest of the strawberries with sugar and lemon juice, then sieve.Fill four glasses with ice and share the puree between them.Top with soda water, stir gently, and finish with a halved strawberry and lemon peel.
